result.topic_en: A draft of the opening definitions of Riemann's dissertation: a function w of a variable z (one value of w for each value of z), continuity on an interval, the remark that this definition fixes no law between the values of the function, and a struck-through start on dependence through mathematical operations; it ends with scattered, partly inverted calculations.

items.english: This definition evidently fixes no law at all between the individual values of the function, since once the function has been specified for a certain interval, the manner of its continuation outside that interval remains entirely arbitrary.
